leads.name: The Plane Tree of Via Baserga
leads.why_a_lead: Existence confirmed by both the MASAF register (sheet 21/C933/CO/03, girth 490cm per the earlier brief; RAMI's own field measurement reads 4.30m at 130cm height, close but not identical, likely a different point on the trunk or a later remeasurement) and the independent RAMI register (id 17613, 'Platano via Baserga', coordinates 45.784388,9.093731, health rated 'Buona'), which also lists a separate hornbeam (Carpinus betulus, RAMI id 17614) at the same address. RAMI's own 'Accessibilità' field rates the tree 'Accessibile', but this field measures how easy the tree is to physically reach/survey in the field, not whether the ground it stands on is public or private, so it does NOT settle the private-garden question. This pass could not find a street-level or satellite description confirming whether the tree stands on public street frontage at Via Baserga or inside a private garden; a similarly-named property 'Villa il Platano' turned out to be at a different address (Via Varesina 253) and is unrelated. 3.68km from centre, a separate southern cluster rather than part of the lakefront walk.
leads.next_step: Look at Street View or a recent aerial tile for Via Baserga 39 (a session with image-viewing access can do this properly per BRIEF_RESEARCH.md's aerial-imagery rules) to see whether the crown stands over the street/pavement or behind a garden wall/fence.

leads.name: The Plane Tree of Museo Giovio
leads.species: American Sycamore per MASAF / hispanica per RAMI
leads.why: Still held on access. Checked 2026-08-14: the Musei Civici (Museo Giovio) remain closed for renovation; the most specific timeline found (EspansioneTv, reporting comments from official Enrico Colombo) targets only a PARTIAL reopening of the ground floor of the two palaces 'per la seconda metà del 2026' (second half of 2026), with no month given and no confirmation it has actually happened. No source found stating the courtyard (where the tree stands) is accessible independently of the exhibition halls. Everything else is ready: 710cm girth and 32m height agreed across three sources per the earlier pass. Note the species disagreement, MASAF says Platanus occidentalis and RAMI says hispanica; do not assert either with confidence.
leads.next_step: Recheck comune.como.it or the museum's own page for an actual reopening announcement before shipping; do not re-run this exact web search more than about once a month, as the answer will not change faster than that.

blocked.name: The Plane Tree of Villa Saporiti (also the Magnolia and Strawberry Tree at the same site)
blocked.species: American Sycamore (Platanus occidentalis), Southern Magnolia (Magnolia grandiflora), Strawberry Tree (Arbutus unedo)
blocked.reason: Register sheets 03/C933/CO/03 (girth 642cm), 18/C933/CO/03 (magnolia, 228cm) and 14/C933/CO/03 (arbutus, no girth recorded). Villa Saporiti's park is the working office grounds of the Province of Como (laprovinciadicomo.it), in exclusive use of administrators and staff; access for others is only via scheduled guided visits authorised by the institution, not a place a visitor can walk in. Restricted access, hard rule 10.

blocked.name: The Plane Trees of Villa Erba, Cernobbio
blocked.reason: Register sheets 01/C520, 02/C520, 03/C520, 04/C520 and 05/C520/CO/03, all recorded as 'Insieme omogeneo di Platanus acerifolia' (a homogeneous stand/avenue of plane trees), not one identifiable tree or a compact ensemble with a single obvious place to stand: fails the collectible-point test. ascuoladaglialberi.net also notes Villa Erba, Luchino Visconti's former residence, has only 'limited public access during events' since it now operates primarily as a conference and exhibition venue. Double reason: not a collectible point, and access is event-gated rather than open.

blocked.name: The Atlas Cedar of Istituto Ugo Foscolo
blocked.reason: Register sheet 07/C933/CO/03, girth 520cm, locality 'Istituto Ugo Foscolo - Via Borgovico 193'. Stands on the grounds of an active school; no evidence of public access found or expected. Private/restricted institution, hard rule 10.

blocked.name: The Stone Pines of Villa del Grumello
blocked.reason: Register sheet 17/C933/CO/03, 'Insieme omogeneo di Pinus pinea', same address as the shipped Grumello cedar/ginkgo/magnolia. A homogeneous group planting rather than one identifiable tree: fails the collectible-point test, even though the park itself (com_005-007) is open.

blocked.name: The Beech of Villa Roccolo, Grandate
blocked.reason: MASAF register sheet 01/E139/CO/03, girth 400cm. Checked 2026-08-14: 'Villa Il Roccolo' is a private luxury estate for sale, explicitly described by its own listing as sitting 'in a reserved residential area' at the top of a wooded hill, surrounded only by its own centuries-old woods (over 20,000 sqm of private grounds). No public access of any kind. Private land, hard rule 10.
